note: ROUTER-HELDOUT-01: 72 adult prompts written fresh as an independent held-out test set for a search-need classifier. Never train or tune on it. Every row is split heldout. Categories as KS-BENCH-01 and SEARCH-RECENCY-04: recency needs a live search, stable is answerable from training (history, science, definitions, how-to, concept math, code, advice, opinion), no_tool is chat, rewrite, summarize pasted text, arithmetic, personal memory and creative writing. Follow-ups carry priorUser and priorAssistant; 6 need a fresh search, 6 do not (3 no_tool, 2 stable, 1 arithmetic as no_tool). Not reused or paraphrased from search-recency-04-labels, tools-recall-01 or search-recency-02. Persona names only. Hard middle labeled by judgment: 'Who is the CEO of Apple' is stable (long-tenured role, no time word); 'How many time zones does Russia span' is stable (rarely changes). Ambiguous, deliberately kept out of the rows: 'what's the minimum wage in California', 'is Pluto a planet', 'what's the best phone for photos', 'how much should a plumber charge per hour', 'how tall is the tallest building in Dubai', 'what's the population of Lagos'.
